chapter: Mambo, the Palladium and Cubop City
title: Cubop City and the Royal Roost
summary: The club above Jack Dempsey's opened with Artie Shaw and Machito, with Symphony Sid broadcasting from the Roost and Club Clique, later Birdland.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Uh-Huh, okay. Ahh you also had a place called Cubop City, which that's the name that Symphony Sid gave it. You used to be located above Jack Dempsey's on 51st Street. How did you get to work there?
Well, we were established as a Afro-Cuban jazz orchestra so, as a matter of fact, the opening was by Artie Shaw and myself.
Artie Shaw?
Yeah, Artie Shaw had about twenty-four pieces, with violins, because he finished at the Strand Theatre....
Uh - Huh.

.... Remember the Strand Theatre? They used to run--you was ,very young, and there was all those jazz like Benny Goodman and Tommy Dorsey and Paramount and all those theatres they used to run the ......
Okay, how did the Afro-Cuban or Cubop City start? What made it become so popular that people used to pack it on Monday nights?
Oh, well!! They had the best. King Cole Trio, Ella Fitzgerald with her trio, ahh - Artie Shaw .....
Okay, let me ask you this, did the Cubop City recordings come before Cubop City or did it come after?
No, after.
After. Okay. Was Symphony Sid promoting you and Cubop City?
Yes.
They were.
Well, because they had a - I mean, the big thing started from the Clique .....
Club Clique.
Club Clique and then they convert in Birdland. They put that name in, you know, paying tribute to Charlie Parker because they called him The Bird.
Okay, so the Club Clique first was Birdland then, right?
Yeah, Birdland, so they had a radio station from there. They had a live from there, so they was live program every night.
From the Club Clique?
Yes.
What about from the Royal Roost?
Well, before the Club Clique-- The Royal Roost, we had broadcasting with, what you call it, Symphony Sid.
Symphony Sid. Was there a club called Bob City?
Yes.
Where was that located at?
The one that used to be the -- on top of ---
Jack Dempsey's?
Yeah, Jack Dempsey's.
Okay, so where was the Royal Roost located?
The Royal Roost was across the street.
They were both operating at the same time?
Yes.
So if you weren't at the Royal Roost, you would be at Bop City.
Yes.
